abilities: The Echo of Jawae erupts in soul fire, inflicting Fire damage split evenly between players within 10 yards. Slithering Flames seek out players who are not hit by the pyre.
The flames explode, incinerating corpses and Restless Amani within 4 yards. Inflicts Fire damage to players and an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.

A cultist's spirit materializes, inflicting Shadow damage to players within 6 yards. Necrotic energy clings to the spirit, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing movement speed of players standing within it by 40%.
Restless Amani erupt in necrosis, inflicting Plague damage to all players and an additional Plague damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. This effect stacks.
Nek'zali launches spectral echoes in the direction of her primary target that burst on impact, inflicting Shadow damage to all players. This damage is reduced the farther each echo travels.
Nek'zali's melee attacks tear away a part of the target's soul, inflicting Shadow damage every 3 sec and reducing healing and absorption effects received by 5% for 15 sec. This effect stacks.
The Soulcoil Well churns, granting Nek'zali energy. Inflicts Shadow damage to all players and an additional Shadow damage every 2 sec for 44 sec. This effect stacks.

A Drowned Echo awakens within the well, periodically pulling players towards the well and inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to all players until it is defeated. Players may enter the well while the echo lives, and are marked with Soul Exhaustion upon leaving.

While under the effects of Mor'zahi's Command, First Mate Nama marks three players then leaps to each of their locations. Each impact inflicts Physical damage split evenly among players within 6 yds and knocks them back. If Mighty Thud fails to hit a player, it inflicts Physical damage to all players.
Scrollsage Iku gathers arcane power and teleports to the location of a player, inflicting Arcane damage to all players. Players farther from Scrollsage Iku's target receive less damage.
A shockwave from an Explosive Bomb inflicts Fire damage and Fire damage every 1 sec for 10 sec to players it contacts.
Stomping on crates of junk inflicts Physical bleeding damage to all players and causes them to bleed for damage every 1 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.
Mor'zahi gathers power slowly for his final ascension. Upon channeling, he inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec to all players.

While under the effects of Mor'zahi's Command, Trader Gebbo throws crates from his inventory which inflict Physical damage to players within 3 yds of their impact locations. Stepping on a crate breaks it, inflicting Splinters.
Mor'zahi glows with ancient power, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec to all players.
Scrollsage Iku blasts a player with elemental magic, inflicting Frostfire damage along with Frostfire damage every 1 sec while reducing their movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.
The Breath of Ula'tek sprays forth many toxic droplets, which each erupt into Noxious Blast after 16 sec. Players can destroy the droplets by stepping on top of them, suffering Nature damage.
Blood venom from the Blood of Ula'tek creates a toxic pool upon expiration, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within. Greater applications of blood venom create larger toxic pools.
The Blood of Ula'tek applies its mark to players within 40 yards every 5 sec, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec for 40 sec. This effect stacks.
The Venom Coagulation continually radiates a contaminating essence, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 3 sec.
Venom slime ejected by the Breath of Ula'tek returns to the golem after 4 sec, inflicting Nature damage to players struck.
The Breath of Ula'tek applies its mark to players within 40 yards every 5 sec, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec for 40 sec. This effect stacks.
Waves of plague venom erupt from the target, inflicting Plague damage to players hit.

The Sentinels combine fluids to infect all players with an entangled blood venom, inflicting Plague damage every 2 sec for 28 sec. A victim colliding with another player combines the strength of the venom. Reaching exactly applications of Helical Toxins neutralizes the venom, removing it harmlessly.
Vashnik infects players with a flame venom that inflicts Fire damage every 1.5 sec. Upon removal, the infected player will erupt in a Caustic Explosion.
The Toxic Droplet violently explodes, inflicting Nature damage to all players.

The Blood of Ula'tek marks a player with unstable miasma. After 8 sec, the miasma erupts, inflicting Shadow damage split evenly among players within 7.5 yards. This impact spreads applications of Clinging Murk among the targets struck.
Clinging blood venom inflicts Shadow damage every 2 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.
An eruption of dark venom that inflicts Shadow damage to players within 3.5 yards of the impact location.
The infected player explodes, inflicting Fire damage to all players.

Vashnik infects several players with a shadow venom that inflicts Shadow damage every 1.5 sec and absorbs the next healing. While the infection lasts, the infected player periodically casts Stygian Burst.
Burning Venoms explode when destroyed, inflicting Fire damage to all players [.].
Burning Venom pulses with flame, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 3 sec.
Shrouded Venoms burst when destroyed, spraying shadow venom that inflicts Shadow damage to players within 3 yards of its impact locations.
Vashnik draws venom from the Fountain of Shadow, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.
A toxic spray that inflicts Nature damage to players within 6 yards of the impact locations. If Catalytic Bile fails to hit at least one player, Nature damage is inflicted to all players instead.

Sszorak forms vortices of poisonous wind which spiral around the arena. These inflict Nature damage plus an additional Nature damage every 1 sec and reduce movement speed by 30% for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

Sszorak heaves fresh venom onto several players, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec. Upon expiration, the venom detonates forming a Viscous Cyst and inflicting Nature damage to all players, decreasing in damage as distance increases.
The Altar of the Six Winds emits a caustic mist, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 2 sec.

Sszorak rakes his venom-coated claws in a frontal cone, inflicting Nature damage split evenly among players struck and afflicting them with Mutilated Gash. If Mutilate strikes or fewer players, it inflicts deadly damage.
Sszorak slashes repeatedly, inflicting Physical damage to all players in a frontal cone and increasing their damage taken from Ravage by 300% for 25 sec. This effect stacks.
Toxifies a target for 5 sec, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec. Upon removal the toxin bursts, inflicting Nature damage to players struck and afflicting them with Virulence.

A glob of unstable toxin forms for 2 min. Upon contact or expiration, the glob bursts, knocking all players away and inflicting Nature damage. The toxin then inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec and reduces movement speed by 30% for 5 sec. This effect stacks. The toxins cling to players, allowing them to better adhere to the ground while it persists.

Vexhul funnels toxin into her current target for 5 sec, inflicting Nature damage every 0.5 sec and ejecting acid nearby. Each acid splash inflicts Nature damage and applies Eternal Venom to players within 4 yards, forming a Caustic Globule at the impact location.
Being struck by some abilities causes an everlasting venom to course through the target's veins, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

Ithraz showers the platform with globs of gore for 10 min. Each impact inflicts Shadow damage to players within 4 yards. Throughout the storm, Ithraz inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 3 sec.

An acidic globule forms and ruptures after 10 sec, inflicting Nature damage and applying Eternal Venom to all players. Upon contact, the globule instead only affects that player.
Ithraz lances his current target with gore if they are out of range, inflicting Shadow damage.

A mutated venom that reacts violently to the player, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to players nearby for 5 sec. Violently explodes nearby globules, triggering 20 Venom Ruptures. Upon expiring, creates a Virulent Mutation.

A toxic globule that pulses with venom, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 2 sec. Triggers a Venom Rupture when destroyed. Stepping on the globule attaches itself to the player, applying Volatile Venom.
The player's soul is fractured until their Soul Fragments are recovered. Stepping on a fragment reclaims part of their soul, inflicting Shadow damage. Upon expiration, the player ceases to exist.

Zul'jan unleashes a mighty cleave at his current target, inflicting Physical damage to players in a frontal cone and increasing their damage taken from Sever by 200% for 33 sec. Destroys Coalesced Venoms.
When two Manifestations come into contact their shared anguish resonates violently, both inflicting Shadow damage to their fixated target every 1 sec for 5 sec.

Zul'jan throws his axe at a player, inflicting Shadow damage split evenly among players within 9 yards of the targetand causing them to absorb the next healing. The axe then swells with necrotic energies before erupting with a Death's Embrace. If Grim Guillotine fails to hit at least players, the axe instead inflicts a Grim Execution.

Zul'jan unleashes a devastating cleave at his current target, inflicting Shadow damage to players in a frontal cone. Increases their damage taken from Blighted Sever by 200% for 45 sec and afflicts them with Gravebound. Destroys Coalesced Venoms and Manifestations of Dread.
The nearby explosion inflicts Shadow damage to players at least 40 yards away from the epicenter.
The player's soul is fractured until their Soul Fragments are recovered. Stepping on a fragment reclaims part of their soul, inflicting Shadow damage. Upon expiration, the player ceases to exist.
The reawakened spirit holds a grudge against living creatures, releasing dark blasts of energy that inflict Shadow damage to random players every 3 sec.
Ula'tek rages, inflicting Nature damage every 4 sec to all players for 20 sec and causing Falling Debris to impact several random destinations. Flying into this rage exposes Ula'tek's Venomous Heart.

Ula'tek's Spectral Coils rise above the platform and crush anything beneath them, inflicting Nature damage to all players. This damage is reduced by the number of players within 10 yards of the impact location.

Ula'tek destroys a portion of the platform, drawing her prey closer and inflicting Nature damage and knocking back players within 13 yards. Additionally, players outside 13 yards are inflicted with Nature damage.

Ula'tek sends waves of venom across the platform, inflicting Nature damage on impact and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec to players in their path. This effect stacks. Waves that connect with Ula'tek's eggs cause them to instantly hatch.

Players that leech Serpent's Bite purge their venom after 5 sec. In addition, Volatile Purge increases damage taken from Deadly Venom by 25%.
As Ula'tek disturbs the pool, Necrotic Vapors fill the room, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to all players. This effect stacks.

The Doomscale Warden sinks fangs into random players, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec and reduces their movement speed by 45% while the Grasping Fangs are unbroken. Snapping the fang inflicts Blight Vein.
